capabilities: Convert pictures to JPEG XL on paste or across a note or vault
Revert conversions or restore original JPEGs
Keep or trash originals on conversion
extras: The repository also stores files that Rapier (rapier.website) and its agent plugins load; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Converted vaults open on other devices only where the plugin is installed.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to compress pasted or existing pictures or to display JPEG XL files, so image-heavy vaults stay large.
summary: Image converter that turns PNG, JPEG, WebP and GIF attachments into smaller JPEG XL files and lets notes display .jxl images.
